title: TestResult
description: The document printed by `notlob test --json`. Stdout holds only this document; diagnostics go to stderr. Exit codes are unchanged by --json. `version` is bumped on a breaking change.

summary.description: Counts over the run. `failed` counts FAIL and ERROR claims and any module that could not be parsed or checked; SKIP claims are not counted.

claims.description: One entry per claim assertion. A single-file run lists only that module's claims, though its dependencies are assembled alongside.

checks.description: Semantic-check findings from `notlob check`. Present in a whole-project run (possibly empty), absent for a single-file run.

address.description: Claim address, e.g. pkg/calc#example#1. Stable across edits, unlike `line`.

source.description: The assertion text (for a ~property, its sigil).

file.description: Path of the module file relative to the project root, with forward slashes. The bare file name if the module is outside a project.

line.description: 1-based line of the assertion in `file` (for a ~property, the sigil line). Omitted when unknown.

left.description: On FAIL of an equality: repr of the left value. Absent when the claim is not an equality.

right.description: On FAIL of an equality: repr of the right value.

error.description: Message, on ERROR or a FAIL that carries one.

CheckFinding.description: One semantic-check finding. This definition appears in both check_result.json (`notlob check --json`) and test_result.json (the `checks` list of `notlob test --json`); a test keeps the two identical.

check.description: Which check produced it. `names` is the synthetic finding `notlob test --json` reports for an address collision (two things in one module sharing a name); it is not a check `notlob check` runs.

addresses.description: Addresses of the nodes the finding concerns.
